intent.code: Current kernel, UI, worker, tests, scripts and source configuration are intentionally public.
intent.hosting: .openai/hosting.json is public deployment structure and Site identifier, without credentials.
intent.evidence: Public project diary, source metadata, development runner and sanitized campaign/participation evidence.
intent.historicalBaselines: Frozen earlier code preserves original experiments and may retain known defects; the current fix is in web/core.mjs.
intent.mapping: Public sanitized campaign/participation copies occupy their required top-level runtime paths; redundant public mirrors are omitted.

excluded: Credentials, environment files and agent sessions
Model weights, installed dependencies, caches and dist build outputs
Unlisted files, original PDF bytes, unrelated personal material
The kit archive itself and external verification outputs to avoid self-reference
